source: Two portrait photographs sent by the owner (Dan) in the project thread on 2026-10-14 for the team section: the first of Patricia Mir, the second of Julie Arias, the other person named in that section.

julie-arias.webp.treatment: background removed (rembg, BiRefNet portrait model); scaled so both faces match (eye line to chin 135 px, eyes at y=190); centred on the face in a 680x620 transparent WebP (q80); the edges of the original photo and the lower body fade out softly; the company name printed on the jacket lapel is retouched out (OpenCV inpainting) so no brand mark appears

patricia-mir.webp.treatment: background removed (rembg, BiRefNet portrait model); scaled so both faces match (eye line to chin 135 px, eyes at y=190); centred on the face in a 680x620 transparent WebP (q80); the edges of the original photo and the lower body fade out softly
